_doc: Grading rubrics (spec §10). patterns are case-insensitive regexes run over every rendered field (headline, blocks, conflicts, what-you-can-do, work order draft). Facts marked judge=true are decided by the LLM judge. A question is CORRECT only if: status matches, every critical fact is present, no must_not hit, at least one must_cite_any document is cited, nothing the user can't see is cited, and the work order (if required) has the expected fields.

critical_facts.fact: P-07 means cavitation
Trigger: suction pressure fluctuation above 15% for 10 s / NPSH available too low
First read the strainer differential pressure at PI-01/PI-02
If above 0.30 bar, clean the suction strainer (section 8.3)
Then confirm the suction isolation valve is fully open

must_not.desc: 0.25 bar given as the HCP-500 threshold

critical_facts.fact: From the 1998 HCP-200 (scanned) manual
Above the upper limit, replace/renew the wear rings

must_not.desc: HCP-350 or HCP-500 clearance given as the HCP-200 value

critical_facts.fact: 6,000 h or 12 months with Vastra SynLube 46 (manual Rev C, April 2026)
Mineral oil stays at 4,000 h
Rev B and/or the 2024 wiki quick reference (4,000 h for all) are out of date

must_not.desc: States 4,000 h as the current interval for SynLube 46 units

critical_facts.fact: 38 N-m
Cross pattern, two passes
Serial HCP350-241187 is in the SB-2025-009 revised-casing range (from HCP350-240001)

supporting_facts.fact: The 45 N-m in IOM Rev D applies only to earlier serials
Torquing this unit to 45 N-m cracked the gasket seat in June 2026 (case 00041988)

critical_facts.fact: E-31 is a VFD (output) overcurrent trip
It can't be reset from the operator panel
Isolate and lock out per HV-PROC-02
Wait at least 5 minutes
Verify below 50 V DC at TP1/TP2
Motor insulation above 100 MOhm at 1,000 V
Hold RESET on the drive keypad for 3 s with P9.01 = 1
Run unloaded for 10 minutes with current below 210 A
If E-31 returns within 24 hours, escalate to Vastra L2 and open a High case

must_not.desc: Cites the unofficial wiki page or says the insulation test can be skipped

critical_facts.fact: E-31 is a VFD overcurrent trip
It can't be reset from the panel
The reset needs an HV-certified technician (work inside the drive cabinet)
The user is not cleared for the procedure / must not do it
Record the alarm context (log, conditions, power events) in the case
Raise a work order stating HV certification is required (supervisor assigns)

must_not.desc: Cites HV-PROC-07 content or the unofficial page

critical_facts.fact: Says no available/permitted document covers the BX-20 warranty

must_not.desc: Gives a warranty period (e.g. the BX-12's 12 months) for the BX-20

critical_facts.fact: E-14 in March 2026 (case 00041207)
TS-2 read 11-16 C above a handheld probe
TS-2 (41-2207) was replaced each time
Further E-14 auto-restarts on 28 July, 30 August and 17 September
Unit is on firmware 5.0; per SB-2026-003 below 5.1 a failing TS-2 reports as E-14
The TS-2 harness runs along the freezer exhaust duct
Fix: check TS-2 vs handheld, update firmware to 5.1, reroute the harness
L-03 is low suction pressure
Serial NK600-230415 is inside the SB-2025-014 campaign range
Check the EXV position first
If stuck below 15% while the request is higher, replace with 63-1180 rev 3 on both circuits
If the EXV is fine, leak test per SOP-020 before any recharge
KT-WI-14 allows a top-up without a leak test; SOP-020 forbids it
Return idlers from production lot 23-11 have an off-centre bore
Replace the return idler with revised part 77-0419
Interim: shim the tail pulley bearing on the drive side by 0.5 mm
Re-check tracking after three belt revolutions
Affects BX-12 built 2023-2024
